name: Camera REC frame
what: A camera viewfinder over your video: corner brackets, a blinking red REC dot, a timecode that runs frame by frame, camera info and a battery, a focus box that snaps onto the middle. Loops at any length.
origin: HUD / viewfinder overlays - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: corners grow 8 f; the dot on 15 f / off 15 f; the timecode every frame; the focus box 1.25 -> 1 in 8 f, two 2 f blinks
